body.en: Diazotisation: $C_6H_5NH_2 + NaNO_2 + 2HCl \xrightarrow{273-278\,K} C_6H_5N_2^+Cl^- + NaCl + 2H_2O$. Arenediazonium *salts* are stabilised by resonance with the ring and are used in cold solution right away; alkanediazonium salts decompose at once (giving $N_2$ and an alcohol).

body.en: The *diazonium* ion is a weak electrophile that attacks very reactive rings at the para position, keeping both nitrogens as an –N=N– (azo) link. With phenol (alkaline): p-hydroxyazobenzene, orange. With aniline (mildly acidic): p-aminoazobenzene, yellow. The extended conjugation makes them coloured.

tagline.en: How arenediazonium salts are made, why they are more stable than aliphatic ones, and how replacing or keeping the N₂ group lets chemists make halo-, cyano-, hydroxy- and azo compounds.

myth.en: Diazotisation of aniline can be done at room temperature, like most organic reactions.

truth.en: Diazotisation must be carried out at 273–278 K (in ice). Above this the diazonium salt reacts with water and gives phenol and N₂. The arenediazonium salt is only moderately stable. Learners remember the reagents (NaNO₂ + HCl) but forget the temperature, which examiners always check.

say.en: Diazotisation: ArNH₂ + NaNO₂ + 2HCl at 273–278 K → ArN₂⁺Cl⁻; arenediazonium ions are resonance-stabilised.
Sandmeyer (CuX or CuCN), Gattermann (Cu + HX), KI, Balz–Schiemann (HBF₄), H₃PO₂/ethanol, water: N₂ is lost.
Coupling keeps N₂: with phenol (alkaline) → orange p-hydroxyazobenzene; with aniline (mild acid) → yellow p-aminoazobenzene.
Diazonium salts introduce F, I, CN, OH and NO₂ where direct substitution fails, and let –NH₂ act as a removable director.

answer.en: 9.4 g of phenol and 2.24 L of N₂

narration.en: Let us solve this together. 14.05 g of benzenediazonium chloride is warmed with water. Find the mass of phenol formed and the volume of N₂ at STP. (C = 12, H = 1, N = 14, O = 16, Cl = 35.5)

say.en: Let us solve this together. 14.05 grams of benzenediazonium chloride is warmed with water. Find the mass of phenol formed and the volume of N 2 at STP. (C equals 12, H equals 1, N equals 14, O equals 16, Cl equals 35.5).
C 6H 5N 2Cl plus H 2O gives C 6H 5OH plus N 2 plus HCl (all 1: 1).
C 6H 5N 2Cl equals 72 plus 5 plus 28 plus 35.5 equals 140.5 grams per mole; 14.05 grams equals 0.1 moles.
Phenol equals 0.1 times 94 equals 9.4 grams; N 2 equals 0.1 times 22.4 equals 2.24 L.
So the answer is 9.4 grams of phenol and 2.24 L of N 2.

steps.en: Bromine water: aniline → 2,4,6-tribromoaniline (the –NH₂ directs Br to 2, 4 and 6).
Diazotise with NaNO₂/HCl at 273–278 K: 2,4,6-tribromobenzenediazonium chloride.
Treat with H₃PO₂ to replace –N₂⁺ by H: 1,3,5-tribromobenzene.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Convert aniline into 1,3,5-tribromobenzene.
Bromine water: aniline gives 2,4,6-tribromoaniline (the -NH 2 directs Br to 2, 4 and 6).
Diazotise with NaNO 2 over HCl at 273-278 kelvin: 2,4,6-tribromobenzenediazonium chloride.
Treat with H 3PO 2 to replace -N 2⁺ by H: 1,3,5-tribromobenzene.
So the answer is Br 2 over H 2O gives NaNO 2 over HCl (0-5 degrees Celsius) gives H 3PO 2.

homework.en: Starting from benzene, prepare m-bromophenol (hint: nitrate, brominate, reduce, diazotise).

narration.en: Recap. Diazotisation: ArNH₂ + NaNO₂ + HCl at 273–278 K. Sandmeyer (Cu(I) salts) gives ArCl, ArBr, ArCN; KI gives ArI; HBF₄ then heat gives ArF. H₃PO₂ gives ArH; warm water gives ArOH. Coupling with phenol or aniline gives coloured azo dyes.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಡೈಅಜೋಟೀಕರಣ: ArNH₂ + NaNO₂ + HCl, 273–278 K. ಸ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ಮೇಯರ್ ArCl, ArBr, ArCN; KI → ArI; HBF₄, ಬಿಸಿ → ArF. H₃PO₂ → ArH; ಬೆಚ್ಚಗಿನ ನೀರು → ArOH. ಫೀನಾಲ್ ಅಥವಾ ಅನಿಲೀನ್‌ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಜೋಡಣೆ ಬಣ್ಣದ ಅಜೋ ವರ್ಣಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. Diazotisation: ArNH 2 plus NaNO 2 plus HCl at 273-278 kelvin.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ಡೈಅಜೋಟೀಕರಣ: ArNH 2 plus NaNO 2 plus HCl, 273-278 kelvin.

say.en: Sandmeyer (CuI salts) gives ArCl, ArBr, ArCN; KI gives ArI; HBF 4 then heat gives ArF.
say.kn: ಸ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ಮೇಯರ್ ArCl, ArBr, ArCN; KI gives ArI; HBF 4, ಬಿಸಿ gives ArF.

say.en: H 3PO 2 gives ArH; warm water gives ArOH.
say.kn: H 3PO 2 gives ArH; ಬೆಚ್ಚಗಿನ ನೀರು gives ArOH.

say.en: Coupling with phenol or aniline gives coloured azo dyes.
say.kn: ಫೀನಾಲ್ ಅಥವಾ ಅನಿಲೀನ್‌ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಜೋಡಣೆ ಬಣ್ಣದ ಅಜೋ ವರ್ಣಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
